note.en: Density-limited growth with carrying capacity K. It is the simplest biological ODE baseline. The linked original is the later 1847 memoir; the 1838 note itself was not audited. The differential equation is not the discrete logistic map. Scoped executed example: One dimensionless population. Compare RK4 with the analytic solution at every output time; check nonnegativity and time refinement. Excludes reaction–diffusion and multispecies models.

note.en: Enzyme saturation; the full mass-action system resolves the transient complex C, while the rate law eliminates a fast variable. The 1913 rapid-equilibrium interpretation and the 1925 quasi-steady-state derivation must remain distinct. Literature-only.

note.en: Individuals move through age a at unit speed; newborns enter through a nonlocal renewal boundary. This is the classical age-transport form; the later von Foerster lineage is acknowledged without treating its date as the first appearance. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: This is the classical age-transport form; the later von Foerster lineage is acknowledged without treating its date as the first appearance.

note.ja: 閉じた一様混合集団の規格化SIR系。SEIRは曝露区画を追加します。人数と割合ではβの定義が異なります。 限定した実行例：閉鎖・均質な人口割合SIR。RK4と別実装のSciPy DOP853を比較。人口保存・非負性・時間収束を確認。SEIR・空間伝播・実データ較正は対象外。
note.en: Closed, well-mixed normalized population fractions. SEIR adds an exposed compartment and a progression rate. The original general epidemic framework is broader than this SIR specialization. Population-count and fraction conventions give different β definitions. Scoped executed example: Closed homogeneous population-fraction SIR. Compare RK4 with independently implemented SciPy DOP853; check conservation, nonnegativity and time convergence. Excludes SEIR, spatial spread and calibration to observations.

equations.coverage_scope: Closed homogeneous population-fraction SIR. Compare RK4 with independently implemented SciPy DOP853; check conservation, nonnegativity and time convergence. Excludes SEIR, spatial spread and calibration to observations.

equations.coverage_scope: Fisher–KPP is a conventional family name; the independent KPP 1937 original remains an archival follow-up. The exact special speed is not the minimal speed.

equations.coverage_scope: This writes one constant-yield extension of saturation growth, not a universal metabolic model.

equations.coverage_scope: The original squid-axon model is not a calibrated human cardiac model. No single rate parameter set is selected by this survey.

note.en: A framework for diffusion-driven pattern onset around a homogeneous reaction equilibrium, not a unique choice of f and g. A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes. Scoped executed example: One near-equilibrium onset experiment. No claim reproduces original-paper parameters/experiments, mature patterns, wavenumber selection from random noise or biological calibration.

equations.coverage_scope: One near-equilibrium onset experiment. No claim reproduces original-paper parameters/experiments, mature patterns, wavenumber selection from random noise or biological calibration.

It excludes full HH ion channels, spatial axons, patient data and experimental electrophysiology reproduction.

execution_scope.en: Scoped verification of an FHN/BVP-style reduced ODE. It excludes full HH ion channels, spatial axons, patient data and experimental electrophysiology reproduction.

note.en: Cell density n drifts up a chemoattractant gradient; τc=0 gives an elliptic chemical subproblem. This is a common two-field reduction of a more detailed original formulation. Blowup thresholds depend on dimension, domain, boundary and chemical dynamics. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: This is a common two-field reduction of a more detailed original formulation. Blowup thresholds depend on dimension, domain, boundary and chemical dynamics.

note.ja: 流体と変形構造の結合の入口。構造の力・構成則が別途必要で、既存の非圧縮ソルバーだけで実装済みとはなりません。 文献解説のみ。

Immersed boundary is a numerical coupling method, not itself a closed biological constitutive equation. The existing periodic MAC solver does not implement this coupling. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: Immersed boundary is a numerical coupling method, not itself a closed biological constitutive equation. The existing periodic MAC solver does not implement this coupling.

name.en: Chemical master equation and Gillespie SSA

formula: \partial_t P(\boldsymbol n,t)=\sum_j\left[a_j(\boldsymbol n-\boldsymbol\nu_j)P(\boldsymbol n-\boldsymbol\nu_j,t)-a_j(\boldsymbol n)P(\boldsymbol n,t)\right]

note.ja: 整数分子数n、反応ジャンプνj、傾向関数ajの確率モデル。Gillespie SSAは軌道を標本化する解法で、反応網自体とは区別します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Integer molecule counts, reaction jumps νj and propensities aj; SSA samples paths of this continuous-time Markov model. The 1977 paper is a foundational SSA reference, not a priority claim for all master equations. SSA is a solver; the reaction network is the model. A seed documents a trajectory, not an ensemble validation. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: The 1977 paper is a foundational SSA reference, not a priority claim for all master equations. SSA is a solver; the reaction network is the model. A seed documents a trajectory, not an ensemble validation.

equations.coverage_scope: 1983 is the well-mixed CSTR source; Pearson 1993 is the spatial pattern reference. Spot division does not by itself demonstrate cell division or a linear Turing instability.
